acceptanceCriteria: A1: The CI governance inventory detects a current-release archived Work Item whose pre-merge finalization still says unmerged after the reviewed head is present on the synchronized default branch, and fails closed with a stable stale-awaiting-merge-close finding.

A2: WI-222 is preserved as immutable linked history without inventing a second Runtime successor edge; WI-227 and WI-230 receive append-only post-merge finalization/close evidence bound to their real reviewed merge commits and exact cleanup state.

A3: The three reference-parity documents identify WI-222 as a linked immutable delivery, WI-227 and WI-230 as implemented/closed, and WI-234 with evidence and terminal decision paths; no predecessor Contract, Summary, Outcome, Events, verification, or archive bytes are rewritten.

A4: The old WI-189, WI-193, WI-222, WI-223, WI-224, WI-225, and WI-228 branches/worktrees are either superseded with preserved PR/Work Item evidence or removed exactly; no untracked dirty worktree is left by this Work Item.

A5: Targeted governance regression, documentation/parity checks, Runtime lifecycle verification, hosted PR checks, and the installed v0.2.29 inspect/status/doctor/agent-doctor audit pass; the root worktree's pre-existing user files remain untouched.
goal: Prevent stale merged or superseded Work Items from surviving into the next batch and preserve an auditable failure/recovery chain.
intent: Close the post-merge governance loop and remove obsolete PR branches/worktrees without rewriting historical truth.
outOfScope: Changing any predecessor implementation, verification, archive, summary, outcome, events, or historical failure bytes.
Rewriting or deleting GitHub PR failure history.
Completing the deferred full adopter capability manifest beyond the already integrated WI-227 bounded delivery.
Modifying the root worktree's pre-existing recovery_decision.rs or digest_temp.rs files.
Changing global Agent, MCP, HOME, or user configuration.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A current-release Work Item whose pre-merge receipt still reports unmerged while its reviewed head is in the default branch is rejected with a stable stale-awaiting-merge-close finding.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused governance gate fixture with a merged-head stale receipt and assert deterministic non-zero output.

scenarioCoverage.expected: WI-222 remains immutable linked history without a synthetic second successor edge; WI-227 and WI-230 append valid merged/deleted finalization transitions and structured close decisions.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use installed Runtime v0.2.29 recover/finalize/finalize-verify/close with exact digest and merge identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Superseded or merged historical branches/worktrees are removed exactly after evidence preservation; no dirty obsolete worktree remains.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Archive uncommitted patches/bundles outside the repository, remove exact worktrees/refs, and inspect git worktree/branch inventories.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The English, Chinese, and Japanese parity documents agree on recovered/implemented statuses and the current Work Item evidence/decision paths.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run documentation acceptance, parity status, and governance integrity tests in one strict route.

verification: git worktree list --porcelain and exact branch/remote cleanup audit
